📊 MS Excel Shortcut Keys in Hindi

Excel mein data entry, total aur formatting ka kaam shortcuts se minto ki jagah second mein hota hai. Office jobs aur computer course ke liye yeh shortcuts zaroor yaad karo.

Is page par 42 shortcuts hain. Search box mein likh kar dhoondo aur Copy dabao.

MS Excel Keyboard Shortcuts

ShortcutKya hota haiCopy
Ctrl + CCell Copy karo
Ctrl + XCell Cut karo
Ctrl + VPaste karo
Ctrl + ZUndo karo
Ctrl + YRedo karo
Ctrl + SWorkbook Save karo
Ctrl + APoori sheet / table select karo
Ctrl + FData dhoondo (Find)
Ctrl + HDhoond kar badlo (Replace)
Ctrl + BBold karo
Ctrl + IItalic karo
Ctrl + UUnderline karo
F2Active cell ko edit karo
Alt + =AutoSum – column ka total ek click mein
Ctrl + 1Format Cells box kholo
Ctrl + ;Aaj ki date daalo
Ctrl + Shift + ;Abhi ka time daalo
Alt + EnterEk hi cell mein nayi line
Ctrl + DUpar wale cell ko neeche copy karo (Fill Down)
Ctrl + RLeft wale cell ko right copy karo (Fill Right)
Ctrl + EFlash Fill – pattern dekh kar data khud bharo
Ctrl + SpacePoora column select karo
Shift + SpacePoori row select karo
Ctrl + Shift + +Nayi row/column/cell insert karo
Ctrl + -Row/column/cell delete karo
Ctrl + Shift + LFilter on/off karo
Ctrl + TData ko Table banao
F4Formula mein $ lagao (Absolute reference) / pichla kaam dohraao
Ctrl + `Saare formulas dikhao
Ctrl + Arrow keyData ke aakhri cell tak jao
Ctrl + Shift + Arrow keyData ke aakhir tak select karo
Ctrl + HomeCell A1 par jao
Ctrl + EndData ke aakhri cell par jao
Ctrl + Page DownAgli sheet par jao
Ctrl + Page UpPichli sheet par jao
Shift + F11Nayi sheet banao
Ctrl + Shift + $Number ko Currency format do
Ctrl + Shift + %Number ko Percentage format do
Alt + F1Selected data ka Chart banao
F11Nayi sheet par Chart banao
Ctrl + 9Row chhupao (Hide)
Ctrl + 0Column chhupao (Hide)
